title: Claude Code specifics live behind one harness module (headless run, hook codec, usage normaliser, instruction home)
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 3: Claude specifics leak into lane-run/session.ts:53, delivery.ts:56, result.ts:66, context/io.ts, hook/scope.ts:232, outcome/slice-cost.ts, ledger.ts:246, context/gauge.ts:42, brain/global-standards.ts, adopt/adopt.ts.
Outcome: src/harness/claude.ts owns headless run (brief in, {ok,cost,usage} out), hook payload codec, usage normaliser, instruction/memory home; callers use it.
Proof: rule test allows literals '.claude' and 'claude' (binary) only under src/harness (allowlist for user-facing text); npm test.
